product.name: Articulated Boom Lifts
product.description: Machinery with articulated arms that provide multi-directional movement and precise control for tasks requiring access to difficult areas at height.

product.name: Scissor Lifts
product.description: Elevating platforms that provide vertical access for workers and materials, suitable for indoor and outdoor tasks at various heights.
